notes: Clean encode. The cast-time choice between 4 torch-size lights and 1 humanoid form is not modeled via CastTimeEffectModeChoice — both modes produce identical mechanical effects (visual illusion + dim light in 10-ft radius), so a single create_illusion with maxSize=medium covers both. The 20-ft proximity constraint between individual lights and the 4-light count cap have no surface representation; modeled as one area attachment. brightRadiusFeet=0 encodes dim-only illumination (no bright-light component per RAW). reposition_attachment with maxMoveFeet=60 correctly captures the Bonus Action repositioning mechanic, which was previously listed as a gap in silent_image.dhall and major_image.dhall comments — that atom is now present in types.ts.
